scope: Packaging and download publication review, with a discovered revision-parser blocker repaired before final CI publication.
publication_status: No revised platform assets verified in this assignment. Run artifact API initially returned zero artifacts. Source commit must advance for the parser fix; verify the replacement run and source SHA.

blocker.before: Only YYYY.MM accepted; current 2026.11.1 raises ValueError, blocking real package creation and actual payload notice fixture.
blocker.fix: Accept YYYY.MM and YYYY.MM.PATCH, where PATCH is a positive canonical integer with no leading zero. Preserve one-declaration requirement, valid two-digit month, exact full-string match, and newline/trailing-junk rejection.
blocker.limitations: All local archives are synthetic fixtures. These tests do not validate pending native assets.

source_contract.full_commit: 40 lowercase hexadecimal digits; git HEAD, clean tracked checkout, GITHUB_SHA and JUCE workflow_commit must agree.
source_contract.sound_data_revision: manifest.preset_library_revision and SOURCE.txt must both state 2026.11.1; source SHA remains the binary identifier.
source_contract.integrity: SHA256SUMS covers inner archive and sidecar manifest. Embedded manifest must equal sidecar. Every regular payload file has SHA256 and size; directory/symlink types, internal target containment and Unix tar modes are preserved and verified.

verification_sequence: Obtain replacement build run by full pushed SHA, then require every required platform job and Linux/Windows validator job to complete successfully; inspect macOS AU/VST3 validator steps inside their platform jobs. Artifact upload alone is not a pass.
List artifacts for that exact run. Record each artifact ID, exact name, API digest/size, source/run identity, expired=false and expires_at. Require one intended artifact per platform.
GET each pinned nightly.link artifact-ID URL without credentials, follow redirects, and verify the received outer ZIP bytes against API SHA256 and size. HEAD is not a substitute for GET.
Inspect outer ZIP without executing content; require expected three package files and safe names. Preserve hashes from the downloaded bytes.

Run scripts/verify-ci-bundle.py from the trusted fixed source checkout against the inner archive with --expected-commit <full source SHA>. Require exit0 and complete sidecar/embedded inventory agreement.

Additionally assert platform, architecture, formats, preset_library_revision=2026.11.1, SOURCE.txt full SHA/revision, workflow_run_id and JUCE SHA/version. The verifier validates source consistency, not whether every CI gate passed.
Check payload binary headers/roles and complete bundle layout for the advertised target; preserve Unix executable permissions and internal symlinks. Do not execute a foreign-platform binary locally.
Record final run/job/artifact IDs, outer and inner SHA256, actual expiration, verification logs and downloaded-source identity in the release evidence. Only then update README Downloads.

After the documentation commit, GET the exact links rendered in README again or compare them to the verified ID map; ensure all four identify the intended source. A documentation-only commit may have a newer SHA than the binaries and must name the binary source explicitly.

recommended_readme.headline: Verified Circuit library 2026.11.1 — source <full SHA>, build <run URL>.
recommended_readme.primary_links: Use pinned artifact-ID links for each verified platform, not the rolling workflow/main selector. Include source commit and the actual expiry date beside/under the table.
recommended_readme.secondary_rolling_links: Optional separately labelled latest-development links may retain existing workflow/main URLs; their changing source must not be implied to equal the pinned revision.
recommended_readme.expiry: Workflow upload steps contain no retention-days override. Record API expires_at for the actual assets rather than assuming a retention duration. Pinned links stop working when their artifact is deleted or expires; nightly.link is a redirect service, not a durable archive.
recommended_readme.durable_option: A separately labelled GitHub prerelease/tag with the same verified archives and checksums is the durable distribution option; do not claim that it exists or is signed/notarized. This assignment did not create a release.
recommended_readme.wording_to_retain: Separate native Mac arm64/x86-64 packages; host-process architecture matters. Linux built on Ubuntu24.04 and requires compatible shared libraries. Development bundles have no release signing/notarization step. Checksums establish consistency, not publisher authenticity or all-DAW qualification.

additional_doc_observation: INSTALL_AND_QUICKSTART.md currently says host latency63 samples; README says67. Resolve against current implementation before publishing updated bundled guide. This assignment did not change that guide.
